headline: WNBA Semifinals: Lynx-Fever and Aces-Liberty set for Sunday Game 1 tip-off
whyCareReason: Historic sweeps across all four first-round series set up a blockbuster final four: Caitlin Clark meets Napheesa Collier, and A'ja Wilson battles Breanna Stewart in a finals rematch.
teaser: Sunday Game 1s: No. 1 Lynx host No. 4 Fever (Target Center), No. 2 Liberty host No. 3 Aces (Barclays Center). Four heavyweights collide in best-of-five semifinals.
story:
Why this one matters: With four clean sweeps wrapping up Round 1, the 2026 WNBA postseason narrows to a heavyweight final four as teams open Friday media day and game preparation.

At Target Center, the top-seeded Minnesota Lynx prepare for Caitlin Clark and the surging Indiana Fever. Cheryl Reeve's defense will try to contain Clark's tempo, while Napheesa Collier continues her dominant playoff scoring run.

In New York, Barclays Center hosts the marquee rematch between the Las Vegas Aces and the New York Liberty. Three-time MVP A'ja Wilson squares off against Breanna Stewart and Sabrina Ionescu in a battle of recent champions with title legacies on the line.
stakes: A spot in the 2026 WNBA Finals in two best-of-five series opening Sunday.
rivalryAngle: Generational clash: Clark vs the league's top defense, alongside Wilson vs Stewart in a modern rivalry classic.
